items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: They had Nina Mae McKinney, George (inaudible) Washington, Orlando Robison, Hazel Scott, Peg Leg Bates, Ada Brown -- these are all entertainers now.

ctx.x: Could we go back to that time when you first performed at the Cotton Club? What was the Cotton Club?
It was a night club where all the leads from downtown would come

up to this night club in Harlem, you know? They had Cab Calloway's Band, they had Fletcher Henderson, they had Duke Ellington, these are band leaders, you know. They had the Nicholas Brothers, The Berry Brothers. They had Nina Mae McKinney, George (inaudible) Washington, Orlando Robison, Hazel Scott, Peg Leg Bates, Ada Brown -- these are all entertainers now.
